restaurant_name: Mae Nam Subdistrict Health Promoting Hospital
text: My relative got infected with COVID and went to get medicine. But didn't the doctor check that the printer wasn't clear before pasting the label on the medicine, making it difficult to see how many pills to take? Then he dared to give the medicine to the patient. The patient is old. Don't even mention the elderly. Even people with good eyesight can't tell how many pills to take. If the patient takes it without knowing the number, who will be responsible? Please check before giving the medicine to the patient. I beg you.
